D.t: Colin Allred leads by 56.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 138,076 votes; a one point swing is about 1,225 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +49.8 and D +62.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $0 helping Patrick Gillespie and $50K helping Colin Allred.

R.t: Patrick Gillespie trails by 56.4 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 69,038 voters switching sides, or 138,076 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +62.0 and D +49.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
